desc_en: Inspired by coastal currents and contemporary aesthetics, these swim trunks present a fluid design with a blurred pattern evoking distant horizons. Crafted from recycled fabrics, they offer a seamless balance between refined tailoring and absolute comfort. Each piece is crafted exclusively upon request to ensure timeless exclusivity. Ideal for water-side residences and sophisticated summer days. Available exclusively with worldwide shipping.

Disponible exclusivamente con envío mundial.
